sentences.text: On the last date of hearing i.e., on 01.04.2024, this Court noted the absence of learned counsel for the petitioner and also noted the conduct of the learned counsel for the petitioner in not addressing the arguments.
The writ petition is of the year 2017.

The order under challenge is the inaction on the part of the respondents - authorities in not implementing the acquired lands and therefore, acquisition has lapsed.
3.
Learned counsel Sri Krupa Sagar Patil appearing for respondent No.2, 4 and 5 submits that the scheme has already been implemented.
